gallery.heading: Inside the clinic, <mark>one visit at a time.</mark>

story.heading: Caring and knowledgeable, on purpose
paragraphs: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic is a full-service veterinary clinic and surgical facility in Northeast Philadelphia. Its staff are committed to the health and well-being of the animals in their care, and they say so in plain words.

Running as a non-profit changes the math. The clinic exists to treat dogs and cats well, not to sell them extras, and the phone number sits at the top of everything because a call is still the fastest way in.

experience.heading: How a visit works
items: Call to make an appointment today. The clinic books by phone, so one call sets the whole visit.
Bring your dog or cat to Dutton Road, with parking at the building and directions on the site.
Surgery, dentistry, and boarding stay in-house, so follow-ups happen with the same team.

feature.heading: Surgery without a second address
feature.text: The surgical facility is part of the clinic, so a diagnosis, the procedure, and the recheck all happen with the people who already know your pet.

closing.heading: Call to make an appointment today

story.heading: One kitchen, two cuisines
paragraphs: Eastern Dragon has served North Wales from Upper State Road with a menu that refuses to pick a side: authentic Chinese classics on one page, sushi rolls and tempura on the next.
The order counter runs the way regulars like it. Call one of the two lines, order online, or walk in and read the coupon board, then take it home while it is still steaming.

experience.heading: The fast way to dinner
items: Order online from the menu or call ahead, then pick up at the counter on Upper State Road.
Lunch specials like the Shrimp Tempura Lunch move quickly, so the kitchen keeps them simple and hot.
Feedback goes straight to the restaurant through the site, and coupons post there too.

feature.heading: The Dragon Roll
feature.text: The house roll is the reason the name is on the sign. Order it beside a plate of Mongolian Beef and the table understands why one menu covers both kitchens.

closing.heading: Order online or call (215) 855-0366

gallery.heading: The work is in the <mark>racks and the walls.</mark>

story.heading: One provider for IT and security
paragraphs: Most businesses call one company for computers and another for cameras. GO2 Tech has handled both from Springfield since 2002, which is why the phrase managed IT and security provider sits in its own description.
The award-winning part is earned on ordinary days: patched networks, backups that restore, cabling that is labeled, and a surveillance system someone can actually pull footage from.

experience.heading: What working with GO2 looks like
items: A consultation on site at your office, not a quote generated from a form.
Managed services with remote support first and a technician on Baltimore Pike when hands are needed.
Data recovery and disaster recovery plans written down before anything goes wrong.

feature.heading: Security you can see and security you cannot
feature.text: Camera systems and access control on one side, firewalls and endpoint protection on the other. GO2 Tech designs both together so the gaps between vendors disappear.

closing.heading: Innovative IT and security solutions, since 2002

story.heading: Why the Main Line consigns here
paragraphs: Home Furnishing Consignment sits in the Gateway Shopping Center on East Swedesford Road, where a steady stream of Main Line households drop off the furniture they have outgrown and pick up the pieces someone else did.
The store's own advice is the whole business model: shop early and often. Items arrive daily, prices stay appealing, and the return policy stays reasonable so nobody has to gamble on a sofa.

experience.heading: Shopping and consigning
items: Walk the floor in Wayne seven days a week; the best pieces rarely last the weekend.
Consigning starts with a call or a visit, then a showroom spot in front of real buyers.
Buy with confidence: appealing prices and a reasonable return policy on every purchase.

feature.heading: Consign the piece, keep the profit
feature.text: A dining table in a garage earns nothing. On the floor at Home Furnishing Consignment it meets the Main Line buyers who are already looking for it.

story.heading: Truly a Ristorante Italiano
paragraphs: Johnny's takes great pride in the fact that it only serves the finest pasta, seafood, and choicest cuts of steak and veal available. Dishes are carefully prepared one at a time to assure quality, which is a promise most pizzerias stopped making.
The kitchen is flexible on purpose. If your favorite dish is not on the menu, just ask, and they will accommodate whenever possible. Then bring a bottle, because the comfort is BYO.

experience.heading: How dinner happens here
items: Call 610.287.4771 for home dining, delivery, take-out, or special arrangements.
Sit down on Main Street with your own wine, or check the delivery zone map before you order in.
Join the newsletter for exclusive party tray promotions, coupons, and specials, including buy two and get the third half off.

feature.heading: The Regular Stromboli
feature.text: The stromboli is an Italian-American creation with its roots in the wonderful world of pizzacraft. Johnny's version is the one Spring Mount orders by name.

spotlight.heading: Shrimp and scallops in lobster cream
spotlight.text: Chef's Recommendations start with shrimp and scallops sauteed in lobster cream, and the Johnny's Salad of spring mix greens with goat cheese and red onion sits beside it.

closing.heading: Fine Italian cuisine, BYO comfort at reasonable family pricing
